implementation.coherent_epoch_contract: LayaAdvisoryService accepts an optional constructor-owned synchronous authorityEpoch.current() reader. Missing, throwing, asynchronous, malformed, negative, fractional, unsafe, or exhausted tickets fail closed before any authority read or provider inference. A valid ticket is captured synchronously before the first await. implementation.decision_commit: Uncached execution checks the captured ticket after provider/gate/authority awaits and synchronously immediately before journal persistence, cache insertion, and suggestion return. Cache and coalesced paths revalidate source and gate, then perform a final synchronous ticket comparison before returning a shared suggestion. The epoch is part of cache and in-flight keys, so a later epoch cannot reuse earlier work even if visible inputs return to the same values.
implementation.opaque_provider_revision: Raw authority sourceRevision remains internal to authority comparison and journal metadata. Provider requests, provider decisions, and advisory results use a strict 64-hex snapshotRevision generated as HMAC-SHA-256 over a domain-separated label and raw revision with a random per-service key. Output validation requires the provider to echo that exact token. This reduces raw revision disclosure and cross-service correlation; it does not anonymize facts or prove that facts contain no identifying information.
